title: GTA 6 Beat Cyberpunk's 8M Pre-Order Record?
caption:
Sensor Tower estimates GTA 6 had 10.31 million digital console pre-orders by 11 November, up from 7.71 million on 2 November. Cyberpunk 2077's record: 8 million+ (CD Projekt, Dec 2020), physical included. It's an estimate: Rockstar and Take-Two haven't confirmed any pre-order number.
Did you pre-order GTA 6, or are you waiting for reviews?

Sources: Sensor Tower via Notebookcheck and News24, GG Recon; CD Projekt via GameSpot
ig_first_line: Cyberpunk's pre-order record was 8 million. GTA 6 may already be at 10.3M. Real or rumour?
